clue.text: Quickly remove label showing exorbitant price

definitions.meaning: to tear a label away fast in one sharp pull
slang for a swindle or grossly overpriced deal

explanation.surface: A shopper tears off a price tag that reveals a scandalous charge.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means tear away swiftly, and as a noun it is slang for a swindle or overcharge.

clue.text: Smuggle in a whisky or gin when demand outstrips supply

parts.note: to run contraband is to smuggle it
a short is a small measure of spirits such as whisky or gin

explanation.surface: Bootleggers sneak spirits in during a shortage.
explanation.definitionFit: To be left with too little of something is exactly the state where demand exceeds what is available.

clue.text: Be over lavish by adding 20 cwt to a reactor

parts.note: an atomic pile is an early name for a nuclear reactor
a means one, the Roman numeral I
twenty hundredweight make one imperial ton

explanation.surface: An engineer piles an enormous load onto a nuclear reactor.
explanation.walkthrough: CWT is the abbreviation for hundredweight; twenty of them make an imperial ton.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to exaggerate or overdo things, laying it on thickly.

clue.text: Door of a tent a flustered man gets into

definitions.meaning: the hanging canvas piece that closes a tent's entrance
getting into a state of agitation or panic

explanation.surface: An agitated camper squeezes through the entrance of a tent.
explanation.definitionFit: A canvas tent closes with a hanging panel, and someone panicking is said to be in a state of fluster by this idiom.

clue.text: Pooh-poohing Baden- Powell's outdoor theme

definitions.meaning: to scout an idea is an old verb meaning to reject it with scorn
Robert Baden-Powell founded the Boy Scout movement

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses the founder of the Boy Scouts' love of camping.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb scout once meant to dismiss with contempt, and Baden-Powell founded the youth movement of camping and woodcraft.

clue.text: Make a meal of a way to embezzle?

definitions.text: Make a meal of a way to embezzle?

parts.words: Make a meal of a way to embezzle?
parts.note: the kitchen phrase for preparing food is applied to the ledgers, a way of falsifying accounts

explanation.surface: Someone fusses over a method of stealing company money.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means falsifying financial records, pictured as preparing a dish from account ledgers.

clue.text: So far fit for the job

definitions.meaning: until now, as far as this point
capable of doing a task, as in feeling equal to it

explanation.surface: A worker has so far been capable in the role.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means until now, and also capable or equal to a task.

clue.text: A batting team has apparently entered

definitions.meaning: in cricket the side currently batting
having gone in, so now within a building or room

explanation.surface: A cricket side going out to bat appears to have come in.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the team batting is said to be 'in', so it is the in side.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has entered is within, while cricket calls the batting team the in side.

clue.text: Contrivance an Israelite tribe has to obtain

parts.note: Gad was one of the twelve tribes of Israel
to obtain something is to get it

explanation.surface: One of the tribes of Israel has a device to acquire.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadget is an ingenious device, a mechanical contrivance.

clue.text: Frenzied ailing antelope

indicators.note: wildly agitated, so the following word's letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A sick antelope behaves in a frenzy.
explanation.definitionFit: The nilgai is a large Indian antelope, also called the blue bull.

clue.text: Briefly continued in employment despite being bruised

parts.note: cont. is the short form of continued
something in use is employed

explanation.surface: An injured worker stayed in the job despite their bruises.
explanation.definitionFit: Contused is the medical word for bruised skin or tissue.

clue.text: Withdraw-having taken up temporary residence at a monastery

definitions.meaning: to retire or fall back from a position

definitions.text: having taken up temporary residence at a monastery
definitions.meaning: staying at a religious house for a spell of quiet contemplation

explanation.surface: Someone withdraws from the world for a stay with monks.
explanation.definitionFit: The military idiom means to withdraw, and read literally it says one is staying at a place of religious seclusion.

clue.text: One who succeeds as ambassador to a retiring king-emperor

parts.note: an ambassador is addressed as His Excellency, abbreviated HE

indicators.note: retiring means going back, so the abbreviation for the king-emperor is read backwards

parts.note: RI stands for Rex Imperator, king and emperor

explanation.surface: A successor is appointed envoy to a monarch who is stepping down.
explanation.walkthrough: Rex Imperator was the title of British monarchs who were also Emperor of India; 'retiring' signals that its abbreviation is read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A successor inherits a title or estate, the person next in line.

clue.text: Greek character seen around Alexandria

definitions.meaning: the fourth letter of the Greek alphabet
the Nile's fan-shaped mouth lies by the Egyptian city of Alexandria

explanation.surface: A Greek figure is spotted in the Egyptian city of Alexandria.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourth Greek letter shares its name with a triangular river mouth like the Nile's beside Alexandria.

clue.text: That is about 550 doing nothing

indicators.note: about means going around, so the abbreviation for that-is wraps the numerals

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is
D is 500 and L is 50 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone notes that roughly 550 people are sitting around doing nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being inactive or unoccupied is the plain sense of the word.

clue.text: Most important member of the cabinet

definitions.meaning: chief or principal, greater in rank
John ... sat in the British cabinet before becoming Prime Minister

explanation.surface: The leading figure in the government's cabinet.
explanation.walkthrough: John Major was a British cabinet minister and then Prime Minister (1990-97).
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means chief or principal, and John Major served in the British cabinet.

clue.text: Measure of force of current by a West African river

parts.note: the volt is the unit of electromotive force driving a current

explanation.surface: An engineer measures the strength of the flow beside an African river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Volta flows through Ghana to the Gulf of Guinea.

clue.text: Novel attic

definitions.meaning: John Braine's 1957 book about ambitious Joe Lampton
a garret or loft space under the roof

explanation.surface: An unusual loft.
explanation.definitionFit: John Braine wrote a 1957 novel of this title, and a garret is literally a space up under the roof.

clue.text: Old veteran worse if injected with a haemolytic factor

indicators.note: an injection puts something inside, so the factor goes into the word worse

parts.note: the Rhesus factor, Rh, causes haemolytic disease in newborns

explanation.surface: An elderly soldier deteriorates after a blood injection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injected with' puts ARH inside WORSE after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An old soldier who has seen many campaigns is affectionately called this, after the cavalry mount.

clue.text: Attend to view a boxing match

parts.note: to view is to see
a bout is a fight in the ring

explanation.surface: Someone goes along to watch a fight in the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal with or arrange something is the phrasal verb's meaning.

clue.text: Maybe hoarding a Whitehall ministry

definitions.meaning: a hoarding is a large board for commercial advertising
the former UK government department for commerce

explanation.surface: Perhaps a government department is stockpiling supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: Whitehall is the London street of government offices; a hoarding is a billboard, a board used in trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A billboard advertising goods is a board used for commerce, and this was the UK's commerce department.

clue.text: Go in 8th wicket down and thrive on a partner's contribution

definitions.meaning: after eight wickets fall the number ten batsman comes in, so you bat at ten
to grow fat at another's expense

explanation.surface: A tail-end cricketer comes in late and profits from his partner's runs.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, when the eighth wicket falls the tenth batsman goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to prosper at another's expense, and split it says to bat at number ten.

clue.text: Exhibit house mother is about to employ

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for mother goes around the word for employ

parts.note: mum is an informal word for mother
to employ something is to use it

explanation.surface: A mother is about to hire someone to show her home.
explanation.definitionFit: A building where collections are displayed to the public.

clue.text: Be up against an objection

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, the letter A
a but is an objection, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: Someone faces opposition when raising a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that border or adjoin one another are touching along an edge.

clue.text: Where English pottery workers tend kilns

definitions.meaning: ...-on-Trent is the centre of the Potteries in Staffordshire
to feed fuel to a furnace or fire

explanation.surface: A Staffordshire town where potters keep the kilns burning.
explanation.walkthrough: Stoke-on-Trent, in the English Midlands, is the heart of the Potteries.
explanation.definitionFit: The Staffordshire town is home to English ceramics, and the verb means to feed fuel to a fire.

clue.text: Part of the Cush I admire is Muslim

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone admires part of the ancient land of Cush.
explanation.definitionFit: Shia is the second largest branch of Islam, so an adherent is of that faith.

clue.text: Fail to enunciate clearly an aspersion

definitions.meaning: to run words together indistinctly
a damaging remark on someone's character

explanation.surface: A mumbled insult.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to mumble words together, and the noun is a slight on someone's reputation.

clue.text: Spare list

definitions.meaning: thin, without excess flesh
a ship lists when it tilts to one side

explanation.surface: A spare roll of names.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin or lacking fat, and also to tilt or slope sideways like a listing ship.

clue.text: Old London river is enough for Britain's whole navy

definitions.meaning: the River Fleet now runs underground beneath Fleet Street
the entire body of warships of a nation

explanation.surface: A lost London river is enough to float all of Britain's warships.
explanation.walkthrough: The Fleet is a buried river in London that gave Fleet Street its name.
explanation.definitionFit: London's buried river shares a name with a nation's complete body of warships.

clue.text: Party given by dam eccentric type

parts.note: a weir is a low dam across a river
a do is an informal party

explanation.surface: A strange character throws a party beside a dam.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddball or very strange person.

clue.text: Clearly able to work out true mean!

definitions.text: Clearly able to work out true mean!

indicators.note: working out a puzzle means rearranging its letters into sense

explanation.surface: A capable mathematician can compute the correct average.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone competent with figures can calculate, so working out an average proves arithmetic skill.

clue.text: Absorb nourishment humorously one hears

indicators.note: what one hears points to a word that sounds the same but is spelt differently

parts.note: said in jest means said humorously

explanation.surface: Someone jokes about eating.
explanation.definitionFit: To take food or drink into the body.
